lines: | **`benchmark/2026-10-02-toutiao-wall3-prediction/`** | **Toutiao on U10.1+T8+U11i, written before the window: wall 0 = install fails on 5ea/5cd (libinstalls 2c9a5294 rejects libcvt.so at installd_operator:3222; 61b 51e1b525 accepts it; pre-existing per-board split, not the candidate); then t20 timing (Mira 0.6 s serialized retries), 122 android.net stub members missing (`stub_member_gap.py`, T8 = U9), bionic-only symbols in libttcrypto/libsscronet/libmetasec_ml.** |

- 2026-10-02 头条 BMS 安装只在 61b 成功过:5ea/5cd 的 libinstalls 2c9a5294 在 installd_operator:3222 拒 toutiao 的 libcvt.so(ec=8519936→9568260),61b 的 51e1b525 以 reviewed payload exception 收下——U10.1 出包身份表本就三板不一,头条探针排在 61b 或先拉齐 libinstalls;provision_toutiao.sh 不走 BMS native 提取,不能当可装证据。静态预测要到符号级(DT_NEEDED 全在≠能重定位:libttcrypto __errno、libsscronet __cmsg_nxthdr)和桩成员级(NetworkInfo 桩只 7 个方法,`stub_member_gap.py` 扫出 122 个缺成员,T8 与 U9 相同)。见 benchmark/2026-10-02-toutiao-wall3-prediction/(cc-t3)。
